# BETA Social
> Malaysia-based 360° marketing agency helping brands grow with strategy, content
> systems, and performance-driven marketing — online and on-ground.

BETA Social (legal name: BETA COMMUNICATIONS SDN BHD, Company No. 1476361-X, est. 2022) is a full-service
marketing agency based in Puchong, Selangor, serving clients across Malaysia.

## Services
- Social Media Management: strategic content planning and full channel management across Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, with comprehensive monthly reporting.
- Content Creation: professional visual production, copywriting, and creative assets.
- Media Buying: performance marketing campaigns that generate leads and growth.
- Website & Landing Pages: modern web experiences that elevate a brand's digital presence.
- On-Ground Campaigns & Event Activations: event booth setup and fabrication, event booth design and 3D mockups, engagement activities, KOL & KOC activation, and event photography & videography.

## Approach
Strategy first, execution second: Discovery → Strategy → Creative Production → Distribution → Optimization.

## Clients (selected)
ACCA, Benzac, Bank of China, Elsevier, Tissot, Ippudo, Maisen, NH Health.

## Service area
Malaysia — based in Puchong, Selangor; serving Kuala Lumpur, Klang Valley, and nationwide.
